program_specificity.pass_bar: median_z > 2 on the main target and both split-gene halves correlate positively
program_specificity.reading: median_z above 2 (null spread floored at 1/sqrt(n cells)), a positive margin over the null 95th percentile and both half-correlations positive mean the prediction tracks the program, not any gene set of the same expression level

spatial_fidelity.pass_bar: 0.5 <= median Moran ratio <= 2 and the plasma-dense niche contrast has the measured sign, on the main target
spatial_fidelity.reading: moran_ratio near 1 means the predicted map is as spatially organised as the tissue; niche sign agreement means the plasma-dense contrast has the measured direction

perturbation_robustness.pass_bar: Spearman between perturbed and clean predictions > 0.9 on the main target under every perturbation
perturbation_robustness.reading: spearman_vs_clean above 0.9 on the main target under every perturbation is the working bar; a proxy for scanner shift, not a multi-site study

independent_cohort.reason: no independent cohort manifest; set validation.validation_cohort_manifest to a JSON manifest (Xenium or Visium HD rows with local paths, or {"demo": {...}} for a synthetic cohort). The Visium HD trephine cohort of Ohlstrom et al. 2026 (preprint) is embargoed as of writing (docs/DATA.md)

protein_bridge.reason: set codex_table (cell-by-marker CSV/parquet with x, y) and codex_dapi (DAPI image of the same section); no public dataset pairs CODEX with Xenium on the same myeloma trephine
